scenes.spoken_text: Plan a room for two school-age children around sleeping, playing, studying and storage. Coordinate movement, foreseeable hazards and changing needs rather than beginning with a colour theme.
scenes.caption: Plan a room for two school-age children around sleeping, playing, studying and storage. Coordinate movement, foreseeable hazards and changing needs rather than beginning with a colour theme.

scenes.spoken_text: Record each child’s activities, schedules, belongings and assistance needs. Similar ages do not establish identical reach or preferences. Separate shared and personal areas. This project concerns school-age users; infant and toddler sleeping products require distinct classifications and requirements. Turn the family’s brief into a reviewable programme before choosing a furniture arrangement.
scenes.caption: Individual needs first, then shared-space decisions.

scenes.spoken_text: Connect sleeping, study, play and storage zones to the entrance and open furniture states. Review services, window coverings and objects that encourage climbing. CPSC advises securing furniture/TVs according to manufacturer instructions and removing tempting objects from their tops. A layout does not replace appropriate product selection, assembly and substrate-specific installation review.
scenes.caption: Review routes, open states and climbing incentives together.

scenes.spoken_text: Identify changes supported by the product: content rearrangement, a designed adjustable shelf or relocating a unit with renewed restraint review. Distinguish these from modifying a bed or adding an unapproved mechanism. Document a future arrangement and its rechecks rather than promising one piece for every age. Preserve openings and useful shared space after changes.
scenes.caption: Adapt within the product’s permitted configuration and recheck changes.

scenes.spoken_text: One child studies while the other plays. Option A places the occupied chair in the entrance route; B relocates study and retains a clear route and personal storage. Develop B, test opening states and review storage restraint against the selected product instructions. Decision: verify simultaneous tasks, access and hazard controls before acceptance.
scenes.caption: Decision: verify simultaneous tasks, access and hazard controls before acceptance.

scenes.display_title: Prepare individual briefs, two layouts, a simultaneous-use case and a permitted future adaptation.
